description: Northern Ireland Railways NIR Railway Network is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. The Northern Ireland Railways network consists of approximately 220 route miles. NIR network is divided into the various lines, known as; Dublin Line, Bangor Line, Larne Line, Londonderry Line, Portadown/Newry Line and Portrush Line. The link to the route map can be seen on Translink Website. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are Government, Halt, INSPIRE, Line, Metadata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2023-04-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
